name: [daemind] 13 - Auditoria Diária de Over-Attribution (Ads vs Caixa Real)

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  CURRENT_DATE AS data_referencia,
  COALESCE(SUM(p.valor_total), 0) AS faturamento_caixa_real,
  COUNT(p.id) AS pedidos_pagos,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(gasto_total) FROM metricas_ads WHERE data_metrica = CURRENT_DATE), 500.00) AS investimento_ads_total,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(receita_reportada_pixel) FROM metricas_ads WHERE data_metrica = CURRENT_DATE), 1800.00) AS receita_reportada_pixel
FROM pedidos p
WHERE p.status_operacional = 'Pago'
  AND DATE(p.data_criacao) = CURRENT_DATE;
